summary: Blocks a coloured stripe that places a 2px or wider border on one edge of a card or row.
doc: This hook denies a write that adds a visible coloured border on one side only, when the border is 2px or wider. It checks CSS and Tailwind border-l, border-r, border-s and border-e classes. The stripe is a common dashboard UI pattern. Give the object a tint or fill, or add a hairline border on all four sides. A 1px border on one side passes. A border on all four sides passes. A transparent one-sided border that reserves space passes. The hook ignores comments, so comments that explain the rule do not trigger it.
